_comment: DEVELOPMENT DEFAULTS ONLY. Every secret in this file (Jwt:Secret, License:Secret, connection string credentials) is a placeholder. Production values MUST be supplied through environment variables (e.g. Jwt__Secret), user secrets or a secret store - never committed to this file.

Email._comment: Outbound email. OFF by default: Provider None sends nothing and throws nothing, which is what a fresh checkout must do. Set Provider to Smtp for real delivery, or File for the local drop folder (the automatic default in Development). NEVER put Smtp.Password in this file or in the database - the gym settings table is readable by any admin over GET /api/settings. Supply it as the environment variable Email__Smtp__Password, or with 'dotnet user-secrets set Email:Smtp:Password ...'.

Sms._comment: Outbound text messages, used by the renewal reminders. OFF by default: Provider None sends nothing, File (the automatic default in Development) writes each message to logs/sms-drop and never transmits. For real delivery set Provider to Http and describe your gateway: Url and BodyTemplate may contain {to} and {text} placeholders, Headers carry the API key. Works with MSG91, Fast2SMS, Textlocal, Twilio-style APIs and the WhatsApp Cloud API alike. NEVER put the API key in this file - supply it as Sms__Http__Headers__authkey (or your gateway header name) via environment variables or user secrets.

Gateway._comment: Automatic reconciliation of UPI/card collections from a payment gateway's webhook. OFF by default: with Enabled false (or no Secret) POST /api/payments/webhook/{provider} answers 503, nothing is written, and staff keep confirming transfers by hand exactly as before. NEVER put the Secret in this file or in the database - the gym settings table is readable by any admin over GET /api/settings, so a signing key there is a signing key handed to every admin account. Supply it as the environment variable Payments__Gateway__Secret, or with 'dotnet user-secrets set Payments:Gateway:Secret ...'. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over '{timestamp}.{raw body}', sent as hex or base64 in SignatureHeader, and the timestamp must be within ToleranceSeconds of now.

App._comment: PublicBaseUrl is the address members reach the web app on; texted pay links are built from it. Set the real domain in production (e.g. https://gym.example.com).

WhatsApp._comment: Outbound WhatsApp. Provider: None (default outside Development), File (writes logs/whatsapp-drop, sends nothing), Http (a real gateway). Business messaging needs pre-approved templates: map each occasion to its approved template name under Templates, and an occasion mapped to an empty string never goes out on WhatsApp. The Http block below is pre-filled for Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API - replace {phone-number-id} and supply the access token via the WhatsApp__Http__Headers__Authorization environment variable or user secrets. NEVER put the token in this file.

Headers._comment_Authorization: Bearer <access token> - via env var or user secrets only

MemberNotifications._comment: The occasions members are messaged on directly. Each occasion can switch email and WhatsApp independently; the payment occasions default email OFF because PaymentReceiptMailer already emails the receipt itself. StreakMilestones lists the day counts that earn a congratulation. Festivals recur yearly on Month/Day; Greeting is the gym's own wording and may be empty for 'Happy <Name>'.

Checkout._comment: Outbound gateway orders for dynamic-QR collection. Provider: none (default in production), simulator (Development default - full local loop, no real money), razorpay or cashfree. Credentials via environment/user secrets ONLY: Payments__Checkout__Razorpay__KeyId / KeySecret, or Payments__Checkout__Cashfree__AppId / SecretKey. The inbound webhook that settles these orders is configured separately under Payments:Gateway.

DailyAlerts._comment: Automatic daily generation of expiry and pending-payment reminders (the same job as the Generate button). Runs at the next local occurrence of Hour (0-23) and every 24 hours after that - never immediately on start-up. Generation deduplicates per day, so the manual button and this timer never double up. Set Enabled to false to switch the timer off.

Backup._comment: Absolute path only. SQL Server itself writes the .bak, so this is a folder on the database host and the SQL Server service account must be able to write to it. A relative value is rejected, which previously made every backup — and therefore every restore — fail.

RateLimiting._webhookComment: Gateway webhooks get their own per-source-IP partition instead of the per-user one, so retries cannot spend a signed-in user's budget and a flood at the anonymous endpoint cannot lock staff out. Still capped - excluded from the user limiter, not from limiting.
